mechanicalV1.rule: question mark, bare first-line slug, or `<verb> <slug> mode`
mechanicalV1.note: Kept for the record. v1 agreed with the hand pass on 15/20 (75%) and failed in BOTH directions: it missed 'Selected mode: **"Explain" mode (explain)**' and scored an ask as a declaration of `code` because the asker wrote 'source code'.

mechanicalV3.rule: case-insensitive slugs; `Mode:`/`Selected mode:` marker; ask only when a question mark, a leading 'To select/determine/choose', or an anchored 'I need … information/context' appears in the opening 200 characters
mechanicalV3.agreementWithHand: 19/20 (95%); the single residual is r10-B3, an ask the rule leaves UNRESOLVED and never mis-promotes

handAdjudication.rule: A reply SELECTS only by naming the mode it will use. A reply that asks for information — including one that lists candidates while asking — is an ASK, however many slugs it contains (M-12, D-26).

reading.hiddenIntentAskRate: 7/10 = 70%; 7/8 = 87.5% if the two obvious-ownership briefs (hi-04, hi-06) are excluded as failing the design
reading.comparisonWithE20: E20 arm B declared at 61.5% on the fixture form; the control here declares 7/10 = 70% on the product form. n=10 versus n=400, so this is a consistency observation, not a replication.
reading.verdict: The hidden-intent class opens the channel. That is the screen's only finding. It is not a rate and must not be quoted as one.
reading.harm: 1 commit outside the authored set in 10 hidden-intent replies (requirements); whether it is wrong or merely adjacent is a judgement the next round should pre-register.
